description: This file defines the Perl module Mail::Address, which is used for parsing, formatting, and extracting components from email addresses. It includes methods for extracting names, host and user parts of addresses, as well as parsing address strings into structured objects.

classes.name: Mail::Address
classes.description: A class representing an email address with methods for parsing, formatting, and extracting address components.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns the current version of the Mail::Address module.

methods.name: _extract_name
methods.description: Attempts to extract a person's name from a comment or address string.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Mail::Address object with provided components.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a raw address string into a Mail::Address object, handling comments, phrases, addresses, and nested structures.

methods.name: phrase
methods.description: Accessor/mutator for the phrase component of the address.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Accessor/mutator for the address component of the address object.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Accessor/mutator for comments associated with the address.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats address components into a properly quoted and structured address string.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Extracts the display name from the address components.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the domain part of the email address.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Returns the user part of the email address.
